2608.11584.title: EnterpriseRAG: Benchmarking LLM Instruction Adherence and Robustness under Non-Ideal Enterprise Retrieval
2608.11584.paper_summary: Enterprise RAG deployments face a critical reliability gap: while LLMs satisfy 80% of individual constraints, only 26.8% of responses meet all requirements simultaneously, revealing a 57-point orchestration gap. Existing benchmarks assume clean retrieval with simple queries, failing to capture production conditions where noisy documents and multi-dimensional constraints coexist. We introduce EnterpriseRAG, a benchmark of 983 expert-validated samples across six domains that systematically simulates three failure modes absent from prior work: retrieval noise, knowledge gaps, and factual conflicts, coupled with complex instructions. Evaluation of 13 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals a severe instruction adherence collapse, where high per-constraint satisfaction masks low holistic compliance. Critical findings expose deep barriers under knowledge gaps and factual conflicts, even with reasoning-enhanced inference, indicating production RAG requires explicit context-aware protocols and calibrated judgment. EnterpriseRAG provides a reproducible foundation for measuring and closing these gaps, directly informing deployment decisions for enterprise-scale RAG systems. We will release the benchmark and evaluation framework upon publication.
2608.11584.paper_summary_zh: 企業 RAG 部署面臨一個關鍵的可靠性差距：雖然 LLM 滿足 80% 的個別約束，但只有 26.8% 的回應同時滿足所有要求，顯示出 57 點的協調差距。現有基準假設使用簡單查詢進行乾淨檢索，未能捕捉到生產條件下噪聲文檔和多維約束共存的情況。我們引入了 EnterpriseRAG，這是一個涵蓋六個領域的 983 個專家驗證樣本的基準，系統地模擬了以往工作中缺失的三種失敗模式：檢索噪聲、知識差距和事實衝突，並伴隨著複雜的指令。對 13 種最先進的 LLM 的評估顯示出嚴重的指令遵循崩潰，高每個約束滿意度掩蓋了整體合規性低下的情況。關鍵發現揭示了在知識差距和事實衝突下存在的深層障礙，即使在推理增強的推斷下，這表明生產 RAG 需要明確的上下文感知協議和校準的判斷。EnterpriseRAG 提供了一個可重複的基礎，用於測量和縮小這些差距，直接為企業級 RAG 系統的部署決策提供信息。我們將在發表時釋放基準和評估框架。
